0022600096.text: The Timberwolves (1-0, 3rd in the Northwest, 7th in the West) visit the Orlando Magic (0-1, 4th in the Southeast, 11th in the East) for the second game of Minnesota's season, with both teams having played once so far. Donte DiVincenzo is out for Minnesota with an Achilles injury following surgery, while Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, following surgery) and Noah Penda (hamstring), and Anthony Black (ankle sprain) and Jonathan Isaac (knee) are day-to-day with game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and Minnesota lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 132-120 in Orlando on April 8, 2026.
